NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO
LAND PARCELS
Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998
(Section 12)
NOTICE No : 51/1057 Gampaha District

It is hereby notified that any person having a claim to the owner-ship or possession or interest to one or more of the parcels of lands reflected in the Cadastral Map No. 512239 made by the Surveyor-General under Section 11 of the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998 relating to the village of Narangodapaluwa East (Block 08) or any part thereof, situated within the Grama Niladhari Division of 214 A - Narangodapaluwa East in the Divi-sional Secretariat Division of Ja-Ela in the District of Gampaha in the Province of Western should submit his claim to the under-signed before 18th October, 2018 In the event of failure to sub-mit any claim before the above-mentioned date, action will be taken to hold an exparte inquiry to determine title to the land and accordingly publish such determination in the Government Ga-zette in terms of Section 14 of the above Act. The Cadastral Map No. 512239 referred to above may be perused at the relevant Grama Niladhari Office, Divisional Secretariat, District Survey Office, Office of the Commissioner of Title Set-tlement, or the Surveyor - General’s office. Further information may be obtained from the Grama Niladhari, the Divisional Secretary, or the Commissioner of Land Title Set-tlement. K.A.K. RANJITH DHARMAPALA, Commissioner of Title Settlement Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla. 07th September, 2018 10-106/1
